notes:
Extracted the end-of-second-year test on supplied page 6. Paper prints β, despite requested unstandardized b metric. The separate adjustment for first-term seventh-grade grades gives β = .10; it is not merged with the selected test. Replication acquisition: DOI landing page did not provide full text; OpenAlex identified publisher/Edinburgh/Westminster routes. Edinburgh and publisher PDF returned 403, Westminster returned 405; no repeated blocked downloads. OSF project file listing contained data ZIP only and no preprints. Elsevier API default response contained metadata only; FULL view required authentication. No replication statistics or narrative verdict inferred from abstracts/search snippets.
Source follow-up: Published eight-page Intelligence 81 (2020), article 101471; supplied title and authors match reference. Publisher PDF pp. 5–6 visually inspected. Known outcome mismatch: the assigned description specifies math grades, but Study 2 uses average university course grades, not a math grade outcome; target_match=false. The located second-year test is recorded with that discrepancy rather than silently identified as mathematics. Requested unstandardized b is not printed for this test: the available printed standardized β is retained without conversion. The p value and t statistic belong to the same second-year entry-grade-adjusted regression; age/sex-adjusted p=.530 is a different model and was not substituted. The 586 participants in Subjects is a pre-exclusion total; four were removed from all analyses, implying 582, consistent with Fig. 3 groups, but exact analytic n is not explicitly printed for this test, so n.value remains null. The canonical ligatures and minus glyphs agree numerically with the rendered article; no numeric OCR discrepancy was found. Original side is an unassigned placeholder.
